Data Engineering Intern

Addepar · Edinburgh

Addepar’s platform brings together portfolio, market and client data for wealth managers, family offices and banks. As a Data Engineering Intern in the Enterprise Data Integration (EDI) team you will build and test the pipelines that load custodial feeds into the platform, reconcile positions and transactions across sources, and investigate breaks when two sources disagree about a holding.

What you will do: write SQL and Python to profile incoming files, find duplicate and missing records, and trace a mismatch back to the feed that caused it; add validation checks that stop bad data before clients see it; work with engineers and client teams to explain what went wrong and how it was fixed.

What we look for: a degree in computer science, mathematics or a related subject under way; coursework or projects with SQL (joins, aggregations, window functions) and Python or R; curiosity about financial instruments such as equities, bonds and funds; and care for getting numbers exactly right. You will use AI tools responsibly and check their output.
